takeaway: Quick-answer pages lost more views than long reads, even where AI Overviews hardly reached
English Wikipedia: search still brings almost half of all arrivals (Search 47% in the year before AI Overviews, 43% in the latest 12 months; article links 32% to 35%)
Search traffic fell almost everywhere, including where AI Overviews never launched (Latest 12 months: treated editions 56 to 96, French 84, Russian 66)
Kinds of article differ little; sports events and species held up best (Sports events +14% (exploratory) vs biographies)
Editors have held up better than readers in most editions (By early 2026 editors are above views in 8 of 11 editions (descriptive; the H6 test found no AI Overviews effect))
No robustness check finds a significant loss; full window -8%, without French +0%, with a bot-reclassification step -1%
